# Editotsu 0.6.0-alpha01

> **Alpha pre-release.** For testing. Expect bugs; report them on GitHub.
>
> Version: `0.6.0-alpha01` (`1600001`). Installs as **Editotsu β** (`ani.editotsu.beta`), next to the stable app, and updates from 0.5.0-beta01.

## What's new

### Source picker

- One card per release. A release offered in several qualities shows the best one on the card and the others in an "Also" row underneath.
- Card titles use your title language; release group, language tags and alternate titles are moved out of the title into tags.
- The picker remembers the release you chose per show (by release group, and for Editotsu Torrents by magnet). Resume and next episode play the remembered release; changing the source clears it.
- Cancelling the auto-play sheet opens the picker instead of playing.
- Tap the tag row to show hidden tags.

### Openings and endings (AnimeThemes)

- The details page lists a show's openings and endings from AnimeThemes and plays them in the Editotsu player.
- The AnimeThemes server often takes 15–40 seconds to answer; the list shows "Loading from AnimeThemes" until it does.

### Player

- Sleep timer and "stop after this episode".
- Audio night mode (dynamic loudness levelling).
- Controls hide once playback starts; notch margins are redone on rotation.
- A finished episode starts again from 0:00; the next episode starts at its own saved position.
- CuNNy upscaler (experimental, off by default): Player settings → Upscaler.

### Torrents

- Streams start sooner: only the part being played is downloaded first, and the torrent is kept when the next episode is in the same torrent.
- Seeking outside the buffered part no longer waits for unrelated pieces.
- DHT state is kept between launches.

### Other

- Tags on the details page: a "Show N spoilers" / "Hide spoilers" button.
- AniList scores are shown and edited in your AniList score format.
- Optional episode spoiler shield (off by default).
- Extensions: "Update all (N)" on the installed lists.
- Default theme is Ocean.
- Settings → About shows the exact build.

## Known issues

- The CuNNy upscaler runs on OpenGL ES in this build and can be slow or drop frames on some phones.
- AnimeThemes lists can take up to a minute to appear on the first open.
- Theme audio stops when the screen turns off or the app goes to the background.
- Only one version of each opening or ending is offered; shows with several versions of a song play the first.
- Torrent playback is still experimental.
- Some third-party streams use formats the player does not handle; another source usually works.
- The Degoogle'd build does not use the in-app updater.

## Which build should I download?

- `Editotsu-0.6.0-alpha01-google-arm64-v8a.apk`: Google build for most modern Android phones.
- `Editotsu-0.6.0-alpha01-google-universal.apk`: Google build for other architectures.
- `Editotsu-0.6.0-alpha01-fdroid-arm64-v8a.apk`: Degoogle'd build for most modern Android phones.
- `Editotsu-0.6.0-alpha01-fdroid-universal.apk`: Degoogle'd build for other architectures.
